title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police report several cases of damage to election posters linked to the Berlin House of Representatives election, handled by the state security unit. In Schöneberg, a 54-year-old woman was seen tearing down a poster and was released after identity checks.
